title: vxsp
description: The official client modpack for the vxsp server — a performance-focused Fabric pack for Minecraft 1.21.4 with 90+ mods including Sodium, Lithium, C2ME, Bobby, wWaypoints, Simple Voice Chat and more.
body:
# vxsp modpack

The official client modpack for the **vxsp server** — a Fabric modpack for Minecraft 1.21.4 with 90+ hand-picked mods focused on performance, visuals, and quality of life.

## Performance & Optimisation

- **Sodium** — Rendering engine rewrite for massive FPS gains
- **Lithium** — Game logic and tick optimisation
- **Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (C2ME)** — Parallel chunk loading and meshing
- **ModernFix** — Faster startup and lower memory usage
- **FerriteCore** — Memory usage reduction
- **Noisium** — World generation performance
- **BadOptimizations** — Miscellaneous client-side fixes
- **ImmediatelyFast** — HUD and GUI render batching
- **More Culling** — Advanced frustum and face culling
- **EntityCulling** — Skip rendering entities you can't see
- **ScalableLux** — Optimised lighting engine
- **ThreadTweak** — Thread scheduling tuning
- **Very Many Players (VMP)** — Multiplayer performance improvements
- **Krypton** — Networking stack acceleration
- **Bobby** — Extended server render distance via local chunk caching

## Visual & Cosmetic

- **Animatium** — Classic Minecraft player animations
- **Animatica** — Animated texture support (OptiFine packs)
- **Entity Model Features (EMF)** — Custom entity models
- **Entity Texture Features (ETF)** — Custom entity textures
- **Enhanced Block Entities** — Faster block entity rendering
- **3D Skin Layers** — Renders the outer skin layer in 3D
- **NotEnoughAnimations** — Extra player animations (eating, holding maps, etc.)
- **WaveyCapes** — Physics-based cape movement
- **Capes** — Cape support from multiple platforms
- **SkinLayers3D** — Smooth 3D skin layers
- **OptiGUI** — Custom GUI textures (OptiFine packs)
- **Do a Barrel Roll** — Elytra tricks and flight physics
- **Wakes** — Water wake trails when moving on water
- **Dynamic Fullbright** — Toggleable fullbright
- **Sodium Fullbright** — Fullbright integration for Sodium
- **Sodium Dynamic Lights** — Dynamic lighting (torch in hand, etc.)
- **ItemPhysicLite** — Dropped items have physics

## Quality of Life

- **wWaypoints** — Waypoints and minimap
- **Mouse Wheelie** — Scroll-to-sort inventory
- **Mouse Tweaks** — Enhanced mouse controls for inventory
- **MoreMouseTweaks** — Additional mouse tweak features
- **Zoomify** — Smooth configurable zoom
- **FreeLook** — Look around without moving your character
- **Better Third Person** — Improved third-person camera
- **Immersive Hotbar** — Animated, immersive hotbar
- **Raised** — Moves the hotbar up from screen edge
- **View Bobbing Options** — Fine control over view bobbing
- **View Model** — Customise the held item view model
- **Centered Crosshair** — Pixel-perfect centred crosshair
- **uku's Armor HUD** — Compact armour durability display
- **Status Effect Bars** — Visual timer bars on status effects
- **AppleSkin** — Shows hunger and saturation info
- **Durability Tooltip** — Item durability in tooltip
- **Shulker Box Tooltip** — Preview shulker box contents
- **Chat Patches** — Chat improvements and timestamps
- **More Chat History** — Scroll further back in chat
- **No Chat Reports** — Disables chat report signing
- **CleanCut** — Attack through grass and non-solid blocks
- **JoinAutoSprintMod** — Auto-sprint on join
- **FastQuit** — Instantly quit to menu without waiting for save
- **Disconnect Trigger** — Run commands on disconnect
- **ClientSort** — Sort inventories client-side
- **NoRefreshScroll** — Prevents scroll-to-refresh in resource pack menu
- **Remove Reloading Screen** — Hides the resource pack reload screen
- **No Resource Pack Warnings** — Suppresses pack version warnings
- **Smooth Scrolling Refurbished** — Smooth scrolling in all menus
- **Simple Voice Chat** — Proximity voice chat support

## Resource Pack Support

- **Recursive Resources** — Nest resource packs in folders
- **YOSBR** — Your Options Shall Be Respected (persist settings across versions)
- **Placeholder API** — Text placeholder support for other mods

## Sodium Ecosystem

- **Sodium Extra** — Additional Sodium video settings
- **Sodium Extras** — Further Sodium tweaks
- **Sodium Extra Information** — F3 info for Sodium
- **Reese's Sodium Options** — Redesigned Sodium options screen
- **Sodium Options Mod Compat** — Compatibility layer for Sodium options mods

## Libraries & Dependencies

Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin, Cloth Config, YetAnotherConfigLib, MidnightLib, CreativeCore, ForgeConfigAPIPort, ukulib, TxniLib, Anvian's Lib, SuperMartijn642's Config Library, CICADA, Model Gap Fix, and more.

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.4**
- **Fabric Loader** 0.18.4+
- Java **21**
- Recommended: **6 GB+ RAM** allocated

Designed exclusively for use with the vxsp server.
